name: prompt-1048
image_vibe: Analog film beauty collage, dreamlike lighting, expressive emotional sequence
image_purpose: Create a four-panel cinematic close-up collage showing varied natural facial expressions.

prompt.project_info: A 2x2 grid cinematic analog-film collage using one consistent original adult subject.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman shown in four close-up portraits with consistent facial features, natural dewy skin, and glossy but tasteful lips.
prompt.composition_elements: Four equal panels: top-left direct cold high-fashion gaze; top-right playful wink and subtle smirk; bottom-left shy soft gaze with relaxed lips; bottom-right genuine bright laugh with eyes crinkled and head slightly tilted back.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dreamlike soft lighting, gentle highlight roll-off, emotional atmosphere, soft focus, and consistent light across the four-panel sequence.
prompt.technical_specs: 2x2 grid collage, close-up portrait framing, analog film photography, heavy but controlled grain, natural dewy skin texture, consistent subject across all panels, no text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 2x2 cinematic analog-film photo collage of the same original adult woman in four close-up portraits. Top-left: cold aloof direct gaze. Top-right: playful wink with subtle smirk. Bottom-left: shy soft gaze with relaxed lips. Bottom-right: genuine bright laugh with crinkled eyes and head slightly tilted back. Use dreamlike soft lighting, soft focus, natural dewy skin, tasteful glossy lips, controlled heavy film grain, and a cohesive emotional sequence with no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, sexualized expression, distorted face, inconsistent identity between panels, plastic skin, excessive retouching, watermark, text

assets.name: source four-panel beauty reference
assets.usage: Use only for four-panel layout, expression sequence, and analog-film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the 2x2 expressive collage and analog-film beauty concept. Keep one original adult subject consistent across all panels.

changes: Replaced named/identity-based subject with one original adult subject.
Kept expressions non-explicit and added consistency/safety exclusions.
